message_text: The health portal won't accept my uploaded immunization records. It keeps saying 'invalid format'.
The portal accepts PDF, JPG, and PNG files under 5MB. Could you check the format and size of your file?
It's a PDF and only 200KB. Still getting the error.
I apologize for the technical issue. As a workaround, you can email your records directly to health@university.edu or fax to 555-0199.
Why have an upload portal if it doesn't work?
That's fair feedback. I'll report this bug to our IT team. In the meantime, the email option should process within 1-2 business days.
